meta.description: Latest month of electricity demand for each economy, with its change on a year earlier and how unusual the latest monthly move was.

sources.name: Ember Monthly Electricity Data
sources.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), stated on the dataset page: "All content is released under a Creative Commons Attribution Licence (CC-BY-4.0)." Reuse, including derived figures, is allowed with credit to Ember; the site credits it under every table.
sources.frequency: fetched at most once every six days; the publisher updates twice a month
sources.typical_lag: one to six months, different for each country

limitations: One source for every country, so the definition is the same, but each country's figures reach the source from a different national publisher and with a different delay.
Indonesia is not covered: the source has no monthly demand for it.
Southeast Asian histories are short (they start between 2009 and 2019), so 'unusual' there is judged against five to seven earlier years of the same calendar month, not ten.
Recent months are revised by the source. Values are shown as last published; every value is also kept as first seen.
Demand here is electricity generated plus net imports. It includes losses on the grid and is not the same as electricity sold to customers.

finding.label: observation
finding.reason: Arithmetic on published monthly figures: demand per day, its change on a year earlier, and how far the latest monthly move is from what that calendar month usually brings. No model is fitted.
